title: Import Menu
description: Upload a CSV file to quickly create your menu with categories, products, and modifiers

export.title: Export Your Current Menu
export.description: Download your existing menu to edit and re-import later. All your products, categories, and settings will be exported.
export.advancedDesc: Advanced format with all details exported

templates.title: Download Empty Template
templates.basicDesc: Simple menu with categories and products (name, SKU, price, description)
templates.advancedDesc: Complete menu with inventory, modifiers, allergens, tags, and more

upload.title: Upload CSV File
upload.dropzone: Drag and drop your CSV file here, or click to browse

mapping.title: Map Columns
mapping.description: Confirm that the columns in your CSV match the required fields.
mapping.info: Review the mapping below. We tried to match your columns automatically.

family.label: Family
family.description: Name of the product with variants this row belongs to (with the variants plan)

option1Name.label: Option 1
option1Name.description: Name of the first option, e.g. "Size"

option1Value.label: Value 1
option1Value.description: Value of the first option in this row, e.g. "M"

option2Name.label: Option 2
option2Name.description: Name of the second option, e.g. "Color"

option2Value.label: Value 2
option2Value.description: Value of the second option in this row

option3Value.label: Value 3
option3Value.description: Value of the third option in this row

mode.title: Import Mode
mode.mergeDesc: Add new products and categories. Update existing products by SKU. Don't delete anything.
mode.replaceDesc: Delete all existing menu data and replace with CSV contents. This cannot be undone!
mode.warning: ⚠️ Warning: Replace mode will permanently delete your current menu

preview.title: Preview
preview.noData: No data to preview. Upload a CSV file first.

validation.title: Validation
validation.valid: ✓ CSV is valid and ready to import
validation.invalid: ✗ CSV has errors. Please fix them before importing:

success.title: Menu imported successfully!
success.message: Created {{categories}} categories, {{products}} products, and {{modifierGroups}} modifier groups

errors.title: Import failed
errors.familyRowsRejected: Some family rows can't be imported; fix them and try again. The menu was not replaced.

resumen.filasConFamiliaSinPlan_one: {{count}} row with "Family" came in as a single product: your plan doesn't include products with variants
resumen.filasConFamiliaSinPlan_other: {{count}} rows with "Family" came in as single products: your plan doesn't include products with variants
resumen.sueltosQueYaExistian_one: {{count}} product already existed on its own: it was updated, not grouped (group it from "Group products")
resumen.sueltosQueYaExistian_other: {{count}} products already existed on their own: they were updated, not grouped (group them from "Group products")
resumen.variantesDeFamiliaReemplazada_one: {{count}} archived variant did not come back because its family was replaced by another one
resumen.variantesDeFamiliaReemplazada_other: {{count}} archived variants did not come back because their family was replaced by another one
resumen.rechazadasOcultas_one: And {{count}} more row; fix the file and import it again.
resumen.rechazadasOcultas_other: And {{count}} more rows; fix the file and import it again.
